adminPassword.desc: Password of the admin account. Only applied when the server database is created for the first time. No spaces.

modFormat.desc: Mods= format: Build 42 prefixes every Mod ID with a backslash, Build 41 does not.

mods.desc: Leave empty to build Mods= automatically from the mod.info files of the Workshop items. Fill in (separated by ;) to set the Mod IDs and load order yourself.

modsExclude.desc: Mod IDs separated by ; that are skipped in automatic mode, e.g. optional variants shipped in the same Workshop item.

serverName.desc: Internal server name (name of the .ini and the save). No spaces.

serverPassword.desc: Password players need to join. Empty = no password.

workshopItems.desc: Numeric Steam Workshop IDs separated by ; or , (e.g. 2169435993;2392709985). Written to WorkshopItems=; the server downloads them on start.

#!/bin/bash
# Merge panel values into Zomboid/Server/<servername>.ini (Password=, WorkshopItems=, Mods=).
# Mods= is built automatically from the mod.info files of the downloaded Workshop items,
# unless Mod IDs are set manually in the panel. Every other line in the ini is kept.
NAME="$1"
ROOT=/pufferpanel
INI="$ROOT/Zomboid/Server/$NAME.ini"
OVR="$ROOT/pz-overrides.txt"

get() { grep -m1 "^$1=" "$OVR" | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '\r'; }
split() { tr ',; ' '\n\n\n' | sed 's/^\\*//' | grep -v '^$'; }

PASSWORD=$(get Password)
MANUAL=$(get Mods)
FORMAT=$(get ModFormat)
EXCLUDE=$(get ModsExclude | split)
ITEMS=$(get WorkshopItems | tr ',; ' '\n\n\n' | grep -E '^[0-9]+$')

# Where the server downloads Workshop items (<install>/steamapps/workshop/content/108600)
CONTENT=$(find "$ROOT" -maxdepth 6 -type d -path '*/workshop/content/108600' 2>/dev/null | head -n1)

MOD_IDS=""
REQS=""
MAPS=""
MISSING=0
if [ -n "$MANUAL" ]; then
  MOD_IDS=$(printf '%s\n' "$MANUAL" | split)
  echo "[pufferpanel] Using manually set Mod IDs"
else
  for item in $ITEMS; do
    dir="$CONTENT/$item/mods"
    if [ -z "$CONTENT" ] || [ ! -d "$dir" ]; then
      MISSING=$((MISSING + 1))
      continue
    fi
    for mod in "$dir"/*/; do
      [ -d "$mod" ] || continue
      # B41: <mod>/mod.info, B42: <mod>/42*/mod.info or <mod>/common/mod.info
      info=$(find "$mod" -maxdepth 2 -name mod.info 2>/dev/null | sort | head -n1)
      [ -n "$info" ] || continue
      id=$(grep -m1 '^[[:space:]]*id[[:space:]]*=' "$info" | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '\r' \
        | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//;s/^\\*//')
      [ -n "$id" ] || continue
      if printf '%s\n' "$EXCLUDE" | grep -qxF "$id"; then
        echo "[pufferpanel] Skipping excluded mod $id"
        continue
      fi
      printf '%s\n' "$MOD_IDS" | grep -qxF "$id" && continue
      MOD_IDS=$(printf '%s\n%s' "$MOD_IDS" "$id")
      req=$(grep -m1 '^[[:space:]]*require[[:space:]]*=' "$info" | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '\r' | split | paste -sd' ')
      REQS=$(printf '%s\n%s\t%s' "$REQS" "$id" "$req")
      for m in "$mod"media/maps/*/ "$mod"*/media/maps/*/; do
        [ -d "$m" ] && MAPS="$MAPS $(basename "$m")"
      done
    done
  done
fi
MOD_IDS=$(printf '%s\n' "$MOD_IDS" | grep -v '^$')

# Load order: Workshop order, but a mod is moved after the mods it lists in require=
if [ -z "$MANUAL" ] && [ -n "$MOD_IDS" ]; then
  MOD_IDS=$(printf '%s\n' "$REQS" | awk -F'\t' -v ids="$MOD_IDS" '
    BEGIN { n = split(ids, order, "\n"); for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) present[order[i]] = 1 }
    NF >= 1 && $1 != "" { req[$1] = $2 }
    END {
      # Repeatedly take the first mod (in Workshop order) whose requirements are already placed
      while (1) {
        found = 0
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
          m = order[i]; if (m == "" || done[m]) continue
          ok = 1; k = split(req[m], r, " ")
          for (j = 1; j <= k; j++) if (present[r[j]] && !done[r[j]]) ok = 0
          if (ok) { print m; done[m] = 1; found = 1; break }
        }
        if (!found) break
      }
      # Whatever is left has a dependency cycle: keep Workshop order
      for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (order[i] != "" && !done[order[i]]) print order[i]
    }')
fi

# Build 42 expects a backslash before every Mod ID, Build 41 must not have it
if [ "$FORMAT" = "41" ]; then
  MODS_LINE=$(printf '%s\n' "$MOD_IDS" | paste -sd';')
else
  MODS_LINE=$(printf '%s\n' "$MOD_IDS" | sed '/^$/d;s/^/\\/' | paste -sd';')
fi
ITEMS_LINE=$(printf '%s\n' "$ITEMS" | paste -sd';')

mkdir -p "$(dirname "$INI")"
touch "$INI"
grep -vE '^(Password|Mods|WorkshopItems)=' "$INI" > "$INI.tmp" || true
{
  printf 'Password=%s\n' "$PASSWORD"
  printf 'Mods=%s\n' "$MODS_LINE"
  printf 'WorkshopItems=%s\n' "$ITEMS_LINE"
} >> "$INI.tmp"
mv -f "$INI.tmp" "$INI"

echo "[pufferpanel] Mods=$MODS_LINE"
if [ "$MISSING" -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "[pufferpanel] $MISSING Workshop item(s) not downloaded yet. The server downloads them now;"
  echo "[pufferpanel] restart once afterwards so their mods are added to Mods=."
fi
if [ -n "$MAPS" ]; then
  echo "[pufferpanel] Map mods detected:$MAPS"
  echo "[pufferpanel] Add them to Map= in $NAME.ini (before Muldraugh, KY) if they should be loaded."
fi
exit 0
